content:
name: Temporary WP-MVP-0004 EOSR review

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - eosr/review-wp-mvp-0004-initial
    paths:
      - .eos/wp-mvp-0004-eosr-trigger

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  review:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - name: Check out branch
        uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Run governed EOSR transaction
        shell: bash
        run: |
          cp .eos/wp-mvp-0004-eosr-run.sh /tmp/wp-mvp-0004-eosr-run.sh
          sed -i 's/let review = br#/let review_text = r#/' /tmp/wp-mvp-0004-eosr-run.sh
          sed -i '0,/^"#;$/s//"#;\n    let review = review_text.as_bytes();/' /tmp/wp-mvp-0004-eosr-run.sh
          sed -i 's/let wp = b"# WP-MVP-0003 — Stable source and document identity\\n";/let wp_text = "# WP-MVP-0003 — Stable source and document identity\\n";\n    let wp = wp_text.as_bytes();/' /tmp/wp-mvp-0004-eosr-run.sh
          rm .github/workflows/temporary-wp-mvp-0004-eosr.yml
          rm .eos/wp-mvp-0004-eosr-run.sh
          rm .eos/wp-mvp-0004-eosr-trigger
          python3 scripts/sync-machine-docs.py --write
          python3 scripts/sync-machine-docs.py --check
          bash /tmp/wp-mvp-0004-eosr-run.sh
